cohort: 298 pregnant women admitted as inpatients to King Abdulaziz University Hospital (KAUH), Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with a mean age of 32.09 years, were included.
finding: More than half of the pregnant inpatients received thromboprophylaxis regardless of risk level, and the highest risk of venous thromboembolism was found in older women, obese women, and those with a previous history of DVT.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly related to Caprini score categories, indicating an association with venous thromboembolism risk.
